cost.bound: GPU-bound during MCTS policy eval (util often 80-100%; VRAM pegged ~7.7-7.9 GiB of 8.2 GiB). Process RSS ~1.0-1.1 GiB. Not CPU-idle.
cost.scaling_one_line: Prop-logic alone ~15h+/iteration at this hardware pace for 200×1000-MCTS; ×5 iterations ≈ days; ×3 harder theories ≫ week on one 4060 laptop — need multi-worker/distributed or smaller n_conjectures for Phase-2 cost.
